observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 30 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 183.» (L10) and «p. 184.» (L32) in the right margin. The signature 16 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
body L2, L5: «7ᵖ» and «2ᵖ» are written with a small raised italic p (partes).
body L15: the second fraction is printed with the denominator «10×2», one twentieth.
notes_left L9: in «(26 1/4)³» the 4 of the fraction is printed broken.
notes_left L10: in Plato's 1/19000 the stroke of the fraction is printed broken.
notes_right L3: the fraction (166 + 1070)/2 is set in two lines of small figures at the head of the line; its bar is printed broken.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
